// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: EXTERMINATE BUG HIVE/TRIGGERS/EVENTS/OFFICER BEHAVIOUR/OFFICER ORDERS MOVE ==============

column2: Take position on the left flank to get clear lines of fire!
We’ve thinned em out. Let’s move forward.
Advance team located the bug hole. Hope they saved something for us to shoot.
We can’t shoot through our own troops. Not without filing a lot of paperwork after.
Listen up, Lieutenant!
The advance team kicked an anthill, now they got more bugs than they know what to do with. We’re here to save their asses.
Let’s do this by the book - don’t be a hero, and you won’t need a body bag.
Do you understand me? Let’s go, on the bounce!
TAC fighter strike incoming. Stand back and enjoy the fireworks.
They don’t like to get their uniforms dirty, but those fly boys are pretty useful sometimes.
Damn, a few bugs got away. Get after them, before they reach the settlement!
What kind of half-assed containment operation is this?
Sir, Major Cortez reporting. Orders from Command require you to confiscate all civilian weapons.
That’s a copy. Good to hear your voice.
Squad, secure those weapon stashes - not that these guys will be using them.
Let that be a lesson. These colonists had guns, but they didn’t have training or discipline. That’s why we’re alive and they’re not.
There’s a radio tower ahead of your position. It should be able to cut through the interference and get you some reinforcements.
Copy that.
Radio station’s just ahead. Move into range and get Fleet on the horn. Finally, we can break through this goddamn interference
Our mission is to get some reinforcements!
These apes have taken a lickin’. Use the radio station to call up Fleet and get replacements for our casualties.
Sir, Command just radioed out an alert. Major bug movement to your east.
OK. Things are about to get interesting. Look sharp, people. Form a perimeter.
Here they come. Watch your fields of fire.
We've failed.  Can't complete the mission now.
Welcome to Delta IV.  Now haul ass and get behind those walls.
Outstanding! This area’s hotter than we thought.
New orders, sir. Bug activity is too strong. Command is recalling you to Delta IV base. Leave the Civvies and get yourself home.
That route won’t be pretty. Rough terrain, lots of hidey holes for bugs. But you gotta punch through.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: FINAL OUTPOST ATTACK/FIRST ATTACK/PROCEED AFTER ATTACK DEFEATED ==============

column2: Battle’s over. Open up, you rookies.
We’re not done yet. Get on those walls and get ready.
Alright you apes. Show those bugs what you’re made of.
Well done, troopers. Any wounded head to the medic. Everyone else, go find yourself a drink.
Bugs are going for the base. Standard procedure is to keep the gate shut until there are zero hostiles in the area.
Ah hell, guess you’re doing this in the open. At least it’ll be a target-rich environment.
Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.
Sounds like the other company’s in trouble. Let’s lend ’em a hand.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/CIVILIANS UNDER ATTACK/SPEECH: ARACHNID AGGRESSION AGAINST CIVILIANS ==============

column2: Damn it. Either these civilians ignored the evac order or someone’s getting a whipping back at base for missing these stragglers.
Chariot bugs, small, but there’s no such thing as a harmless bug. Splat ‘em and keep moving.
